protocol.name: Compute Budget Program
protocol.note: Tier-0 foundational native program (added 2026-08-08): sets per-transaction compute limits, priority fees, and heap/account-data sizes. Present in almost every modern mainnet transaction (0x02/0x03/0x04 observed live in all three pinned fixtures 2026-08-08). No accounts; pure instruction-data instructions.

instructions.name: RequestHeapFrame
expected_state_changes: requests an additional heap frame for the transaction

instructions.name: SetComputeUnitLimit
expected_state_changes: sets the transaction's compute unit limit
risk_rules: observed live in pinned fixtures (data_len 6 = tag + u32)

instructions.name: SetComputeUnitPrice
expected_state_changes: sets the transaction's priority fee (micro-lamports per CU)
risk_rules: observed live in pinned fixtures (data_len 12 = tag + u64)

instructions.name: SetLoadedAccountsDataSizeLimit
expected_state_changes: sets the transaction's loaded-accounts data size limit
risk_rules: observed live in pinned system fixture (data_len 6)
